lowerCardinalityProof.argument: Every at-most-three-cell subset is all-one-event or at-most-two plus one. The entire one-event source set has a physical q at t=lo; any singleton of the other event can attain the required endpoint there with a free slope because its x differs. Thus all such subsets, and all three-plus-one four-cell subsets, are feasible.
